# ClinicFlow (كلينك فلو) - AI Agent Discovery & System Capabilities
> Next-Generation Multi-Tenant Clinical Operating System & EHR/EMR SaaS

## System Overview
ClinicFlow is an enterprise-grade medical and dental clinic management platform built for single practices and multi-clinic healthcare networks. It provides zero-latency offline-first data caching with PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) tenant isolation.

## Architecture Highlights
- Multi-Tenancy: Strict data segregation per clinic_id. Each clinic operates either under dedicated subdomains (slug.clinicflow.app), custom domains (dr-ahmed-dental.com), or path routes (/c/:slug).
- Booking Flow: Phone-first friction-free booking with Nebras digital QR appointment tickets, WhatsApp reminder automation, and self-service booking portal (/manage-booking).
- Clinical EMR: Electronic medical records, treatment plans, interactive dental chart, prescription generator, and lab tracking.
- Practice Ledger: Dual-entry financial ledger, invoices, insurance co-pays, inventory lot tracking, and receptionist cash drawer handover.
- Regulatory Compliance: NTRA-certified Egyptian SMS sender ID formatting and telecom gateway integration.

## Public Endpoints
- Homepage & Platform Overview: https://clinicflow.app/
- Public Clinic Discovery Hub: https://clinicflow.app/booking
- Patient Self-Service Portal: https://clinicflow.app/manage-booking
- Staff & Doctor Portal: https://clinicflow.app/login
- Example Dedicated Clinic: https://clinicflow.app/c/dr-ahmed/booking
- System Sitemap: https://clinicflow.app/sitemap.xml
